```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, # change this to TRUE for debugging
  error = TRUE

library(sap)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggwaffle)
library(ggdist)
library(ggrepel)
library(forcats)

# Set ggplot theme for consistent appearance
theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  ))
```

```{r params-str, eval=FALSE}
# check structure of params
str(
  params
)
```

## Compare 

```{r compare_plot-function, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
tryCatch({
  # extract variable names
  x_var <- params$compare_values$x
  y_var <- params$compare_values$y
  color_var <- params$compare_values$color
  alpha_val <- params$compare_values$alpha
  size_val <- params$compare_values$size
  title_val <- params$compare_values$title
  
  compare_data <- sap::movies
  compare_plot(data = compare_data, 
               x = x_var, 
               y = y_var, 
               color = color_var, 
               size = size_val, 
               alpha = alpha_val, 
               title = title_val)
  },
    error = function(e) {
    cat("\n\n**Error creating plot data:**\n\n", e$message)
    }
)
```

## Counts 

```{r counts_data, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE}
tryCatch({
x_lab <- name_case(as.character(params$count_values$chr_var))
str(x_lab)
counts_data <- subset(
  sap::movies,
  thtr_rel_year >= as.integer(params$count_values$start_year) &
    thtr_rel_year <= as.integer(params$count_values$end_year)
)
  
str(counts_data)

plot <- count_bar_plot(data = counts_data,
  chr_var = "mpaa_rating",
  x_lab = "mpaa_rating")

ggplot2::is_ggplot(plot)

  },
    error = function(e) {
    cat("\n\n**Error creating plot data:**\n\n", e$message)
    }
)
```
